extension.summary: LibTV - Your Kodi Library as Real TV
extension.description: Turn your movies and TV shows into linear channels with full TV guide support. Generates an M3U playlist and XMLTV guide for PVR IPTV Simple Client, with plugin-resolved streams so channels play whatever is currently on air.
extension.news:
v0.13.0: fix two live-reported playback bugs. (1) Short episodes no longer draw oversized guide bars: scrapers often stamp episodes with the show's nominal slot length (e.g. exactly 30 minutes) even when the files run 7-8 minutes, and that wrong value used to win - real measured durations (the file's stream details, or the duration observed the first time an item actually plays) now take precedence over scraped metadata, which also fixes the guide drifting out of sync with actual playback. The observed-duration recording is also guarded against a stale getTotalTime() reading right after a channel change. (2) When a programme plays to its natural end, LibTV now re-tunes the channel so the next scheduled programme starts, instead of Kodi sometimes dropping back to the guide/home screen - with guards so a user pressing Stop, changing channels, or playing a normal library video is never re-tuned over. Both fixes are not yet live-verified - see docs/live-testing.md.
v0.12.1: adding a Smart Playlist channel now lets you check several (or all) of your smart playlists at once instead of only one at a time - checking exactly one keeps the "name your channel" prompt, checking more than one skips it and creates one channel per checked playlist, named after each playlist, sharing a single order pick for the whole batch.
